title: Powering Next-Generation Entertainment Experiences
description: RDK-E is an open, modular and scalable software platform for entertainment devices and streaming ecosystems. It provides a common software foundation for rapid innovation, simplified platform integration, secure content delivery and fleet-scale operations across diverse hardware platforms.

why.title: Why RDK-E?
why.description: RDK-E standardizes core platform functionality while allowing operators, OEMs, and technology partners to focus on creating differentiated user experiences and services. The platform provides a layered architecture that improves portability, maintainability, and time-to-market.
cards: Firebolt apps, the Lightning reference UI and the Firebolt framework — where portable third-party and OTT streaming apps run.
A single, consistent implementation of core device functionality — the Thunder framework, ENT services, media and DRM, and device management. This is where the Core RDK components live.
BSP, device drivers, HAL implementations, SoC adaptations and Linux OS integration — abstracting hardware differences behind the platform layer.
The layered architecture lets Application, Middleware and Platform components be developed, tested and updated independently.

architecture.title: Everything in the Core RDK platform
cards: The middleware-layer components that deliver a single, consistent implementation of core RDK-E device functionality.
Standardized APIs the middleware exposes upward to the application layer, giving apps consistent access to device capabilities via Thunder and Firebolt.
The Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) between middleware and the platform layer — standardized interfaces that abstract hardware differences.
Reference hardware requirements and device specifications defined for the Entertainment OS platform.
